name: po-o3
prompt:
In server/src/overview.rs, replace the body `todo!("unit o3")` of fn covers with the real code. Keep its signature and doc comment exactly. Spec: `target` is a computer grant's target and `folder` the project's repo folder. Strip trailing '/' from both, but a bare "/" stays "/". Return false when folder is empty or target does not start with '/' (for example the target "system"). Return true when target == "/", when target == folder, or when folder starts with target followed by '/' (so "/home/k" covers "/home/k/app" but "/home/k/ap" does not, and "/home/k/app/src" does not cover "/home/k/app"). Otherwise false.
Change nothing else in the file; the other functions keep their todo!() until their own job.
